sourceDependency: DUB-17 Theorem 2.6 / DUB-18 Corollary 8.2 -> all-weight continuation -> automorphy and residual association -> original Frobenius/inertia -> wild modular good reduction -> genus equality -> characteristic-three differential bound at order six -> actual auxiliary Galois field with positive j orders dividing six.
discharged: Integral coordinate changes between good elliptic models and their inertia cocycles now work in every characteristic, using the verified TauCeti IntegralModel argument. Existing local Legendre models give actual characteristic-three specialization with faithful inertia and equivariant torsion reduction. The exceptional residue curve has stabilizer of order twelve; its action on the three roots of X^3-X has target permutation group of order six, and the kernel acts as identity or negation on torsion. It therefore fixes every original modular coefficient-field embedding. Their actual fixing field is finite Galois over the j-coordinate field, and every positive j order in it divides six. All field, torsion, action, embedding, place and order-divisibility inputs are derived. The elementary wild derivative bounds are also proved at the required orders three, four and six.
remaining: The stronger wild different bounds at characteristic-three order six and characteristic-two order twelve, exceptional-fiber census and wild genus equality remain required. Characteristic-two good models, original arithmetic-action comparison, Frobenius/inertia, residual association, automorphy and all-weight continuation remain required. The auxiliary field does not by itself prove good reduction. DUB-17--20 OPEN; 16/20. No acceptance gate closes here.
shorterRoute: The renewed 24 October search supplies a verified TauCeti integral-coordinate proof, adapted to the pinned local API without importing or claiming a build of TauCeti. Existing Legendre good models, full torsion, specialization and actual modular embeddings supply the characteristic-three objects. Native root counts, group indices and normal-field ranges shorten the exceptional inertia and order-divisibility proofs. The characteristic-three root-permutation R2 successors are used; the failed first linter audit and all original artifacts remain preserved. Incidental minimal-model machinery is deferred. Root pins, proof limits, source fidelity and full completion criteria are unchanged.
